territorial_scope.description: Applies to persons and bodies within Indonesia and, under Art. 2, to processing outside Indonesia that has legal effect in Indonesia or concerns Indonesian citizens as data subjects abroad.

agora_harms: Violation of civil or human rights, including privacy

summary.short: Indonesia's personal data protection law. Covers any person, public body and international organisation processing personal data in Indonesia, or affecting Indonesian data subjects abroad. Sets data subject rights, controller and processor duties, cross-border transfer conditions, breach notification, administrative sanctions and criminal penalties. In force on promulgation, 17 October 2022.
summary.long: Indonesia's personal data protection law, applying to individuals, corporations, public bodies and international organisations that process personal data in Indonesia, or outside Indonesia where the processing has legal effect in Indonesia or concerns Indonesian citizens (Art. 2). Distinguishes specific and general personal data (Art. 4). Grants data subject rights to information, correction, access, copies, deletion, withdrawal of consent, objection to decisions based solely on automated processing including profiling, and data portability (Arts. 5-13). Requires a lawful basis for processing, with explicit consent rules, special processing for children and persons with disabilities, impact assessments for high-risk processing (including automated decisions), security measures, record-keeping, a data protection officer in specified cases, and notice of failures of protection within 3 x 24 hours (Arts. 20-53). Restricts transfers abroad to jurisdictions with equal or higher protection, to binding safeguards, or with consent (Art. 56). Establishes an institution appointed by the President to supervise and impose sanctions (Arts. 58-60). Administrative sanctions include written warnings, temporary suspension of processing, deletion or destruction of data, and administrative fines of up to 2 percent of annual revenue (Art. 57). Criminal offences for unlawful collection, disclosure, use or falsification of personal data carry imprisonment of 4 to 6 years and fines up to Rp6 billion; corporate fines can reach ten times the maximum fine (Arts. 65-73). Controllers have two years from promulgation to comply (Art. 74).

notes: Relations: the only instrument cited is the 1945 Constitution in the Mengingat clause. Pasal 75 saves existing personal-data provisions in other laws insofar as they do not conflict with this law, but names no instrument, so it is not coded as a relation. Several implementing rules are delegated to unnamed Peraturan Pemerintah or Peraturan Presiden (e.g., Pasal 10 ayat (2), Pasal 58 ayat (5)) and are not coded. Entities: the supervisory institution is not named in the text; Pasal 58 ayat (3) says the President establishes it. Text notes: the portal printout repeats some article numbers in its navigation list (Pasal 65 to 72), and the body contains OCR-type errors; quotes were taken from the body text. Pasal 7 (access to copies), Pasal 10 ayat (2), Pasal 12 ayat (2), Pasal 13 ayat (3) and Pasal 26 delegate detail to government regulation. Section status is set to not_applicable only because entries are present; the schema requires a value.

Data Pribadi adalah data tentang orang perseorangan yang teridentifikasi atau dapat diidentifikasi secara tersendiri atau dikombinasi dengan informasi lainnya baik secara langsung maupun tidak langsung melalui sistem elektronik atau nonelektronik.

Pengendali Data Pribadi adalah setiap orang, hadan publik, dan organisasi internasional yang bertindak sendiri-sendiri atau bersama-sama dalam menentukan tujuan dan melakukan kendali pemrosesan Data Pribadi.

Prosesor Data Pribadi adalah setiap orang, badan publik, dan organisasi internasional yang bertindak sendiri-sendiri atau bersama-sama dalam melakukan pemrosesan Data Pribadi atas nama Pengendali Data Pribadi.
Subjek Data Pribadi adalah orang perseorangan yang pada dirinya melekat Data Pribadi.
Setiap Orang adalah orang perseorangan atau korporasi.
Korporasi adalah kumpulan orang dan/ atau kekayaan yang terorganisasi baik yang berbadan hukum maupun tidak berbadan hukum.
Badan Publik adalah lembaga eksekutif, legislatif, yudikatif, dan badan lain yang fungsi dan tugas pokoknya berkaitan dengan penyelenggaraan negara
Organisasi Internasional adalah organisasi yang diakui sebagai subjek hukum internasional dan mempunyai kapasitas untuk membuat perjanjian internasional.
